findings.title: Specify reproducible hash selection and no replacement
findings.finding: Identity-only ranking is described, but the seed, release inclusion, hash encoding/tie order and no-replacement treatment of selected missing/conflicting/blocked records are not explicit.
findings.requested_change: State SHA256 of UTF-8 pipe-separated seed preprint-p05-deterministic-v1, release, targetId, diseaseId, studyLocusId; eligible unique units sort by unit_hash,target_id,disease_id,study_locus_id,release_id. Retain all fixed selected units without reranking or replacement for missingness, conflicts, blocking or candidate performance.

findings.title: Distinguish exact answered status from partial completion
findings.finding: Completion correctly permits answered/partial reports. The exactness definition says every fact and correct unknown reasons but does not explicitly require status answered and every slot exactly once.
findings.requested_change: State that strict exact verification additionally requires answer_status answered, every requested slot exactly once, no critical error, and exact values/bindings/unknown reasons. A partial report cannot be exact even if its populated-value coverage reaches the threshold.

findings.title: Make the permitted parent boundary explicit
findings.finding: Separate source rereads and excluded answer-aware derivatives are described; the exact original-only value-parent rule and quarantine restriction are implicit.
findings.requested_change: Clarify that value parents are approved original payloads/receipts plus validated neutral Task/Snapshot/case-plan/routing/config. Registry captures, mapping/coverage audits, SQL values, old candidate/gold/P02 selected-join descendants and evaluator registers cannot become generation/reference value parents. Distinguish neutral configuration from source-valued InputGraph parents.
